card.summary: Free tier ships with real DDoS protection, no credit card, no time limit.

free_tier.stated: Free tier ships with real DDoS protection, no credit card, no time limit.

egress.terms: Bandwidth is listed as Unlimited on all six plans including Free; the free plan caps players at 20, domains at 1 and backends at 1; ingress: tcp

record.interface_detail: Panel at panel.infinity-filter.com; API access is a paid feature.
record.tooling: DNS record in the panel, no client
record.chaining: DNS in front of a public origin; the paid dedicated IP is the only version that could front a private origin with UDP.

limits.value: Geyser and Bedrock are a paid module: the free column shows 0 module backends and the module row carries a price on every other plan
the free plan is sized at 20 players online

record.binding_note: Bandwidth is unlimited on the free plan, so no byte counter is reached at 1 TiB/month. What fails first is the plan class: the free tier cannot carry UDP at all, because the Geyser module is a paid add-on and the free column has zero module backends.

identity_cost.detail: No credit card is required for the free tier, per the pricing page. The register form was not opened, so the fields it requires are unread.

record.reliability_note: Free tier is limited to 20 players online and one backend; the vendor sells nothing else on that column.
record.confidence_note: The vendor states the exclusion in plain words and publishes the free column of the plan table. Whether the free plan has any hidden fair-use enforcement would need an account and traffic.

evidence.proved: Free is EUR 0.00 with Unlimited bandwidth, Max Networks 1, Max Players 20, Max Domains 1, Max Backends 1, Max Module Backends 0; Backend Module Access (Geyser, Votifier) is priced at EUR 4.99/mo on the five paid columns only
Geyser is not part of the Free plan; Geyser support starts at the Starter plan and totals about EUR 7.98/month with the required dedicated IP
The reason UDP costs money: Bedrock's UDP packets carry no server address, so there is nothing to route by and each Bedrock setup needs its own IP

record.notes: DDoS mitigation for Minecraft Java over TCP. Free plan provides unmetered bandwidth for up to 20 concurrent players. UDP port forwarding requires dedicated IP assignments and paid plans.

extras.wg_detail: No WireGuard offering, and no free UDP port to put one behind.
